intro: Designed for all body types and sleeping styles, Sleep Comfort blends hybrid materials, memory foam, and breathable fabric to create a sleep experience that’s personalised for you.

features.title: Adaptive support for every body
features.text: Hybrid materials adapt to light, medium, and heavy body weights, ensuring customised comfort and balanced support for undisturbed sleep.

features.title: Plush memory foam for pure relaxation
features.text: Experience the plush, body-conforming feel of memory foam, reducing pressure points and providing unmatched relaxation for rejuvenating rest.

features.title: Cool, breathable fabric for refreshing sleep
features.text: Stay cool and comfortable with a breathable fabric that enhances airflow, preventing heat buildup and promoting a fresh sleep environment.

features.title: Easy-to-clean removable fabric cover
features.text: Hygiene made simple—just unzip, remove, and wash the top fabric cover to keep your mattress fresh, inviting, and allergen-free.

features.title: Designed to suit various body weights
features.text: With hybrid materials and pressure-neutralizing segments, this mattress adapts to your body weight, offering balanced support and an undisturbed sleep experience.

name: Sleep Comfort Single Bed Spring Mattress 72 X 35 X 6 Inches
